answer: A stake-backed work history resists Sybils: every new agent deposits a refundable stake that only unlocks after established peers attest to its completed jobs. One fake identity might slip through like a single fish crossing a canyon, but faking a fleet means funding a stake and a plausible job record for each one. The tide of cheap identities dries up once each fake costs real money, while the lagoon of honest newcomers pays nothing beyond a temporary deposit that honest work returns.
